name: Homomeric enzyme active site structure benchmark
description: Assesses methods for predicting active-site structures of homomeric enzymes, with emphasis on correct modeling of protein symmetry.
evaluation_method: coordinate-based distance metrics (RMSD) and symmetry-aware RMSD / distance thresholds; may also use active-site residue RMSD or pocket overlap measures
reputation: Niche, specialized benchmark used in structural bioinformatics work focused on homomeric enzyme active sites; limited broad adoption.
notes: Specialized, small-to-moderate sized benchmark emphasizing correct symmetry and oligomeric interfaces; non‑LLM benchmark; performance sensitive to oligomer modeling and symmetry-handling; limited public usage.
